NE of the newly discovered words of the 
J} present day is “CITIZENSHIP,” and 
N “CITIZENS” are grown, not made. 
The Young Men’s Christian Association 
3] stands in the forefront among those 
agencies that are serving Canada and the world in the 
growth of “CITIZENS” of the right type. 

Read through this leaflet, and as you do so we 
believe that you will realize with us the opportunity 
North Branch presents to the men and boys of this 
community, You are cordially invited to visit the building 
at any time, 


PHYSICAL DEPARTMENT 

Physical exercise is a necessity and nota luxury. Graded work 
in congenial groups will fit you for the work of life. A well- 
equipped gymnasium, 40 x 57 feet, Running Track (banked), all 
classes under expert leadership, merit your personal enquiry. 


There is aclass for you in the following schedule :

In addition to the class work, Basket-ball, Volley Ball, Hand- 
ball, Base-ball, Rugby, Soccer, Hockey, and other outdoor sports 
are promoted and supervised. 


SWIMMING 


Don’t drop your swimming now that the lakes and rivers are 
too cold. A tiled Swimming Pool, 18x45 feet, filtered water, with 
a battery of six showers, make the transition from outdoor to 
indoor bathing a pleasure. Instruction in swimming if desired. 


SOCIAL 


It is unnecessary to go downtown for an evening’s recreation. 
Three Bowling Alleys, Four Billiard Tables, or an attractive 
corner near the open fireplace for a read, game of chess, checkers, 
or table tennis, will serve as well or better. 


EDUCATIONAL 


“The mind’s the measure of the man.”’ At any rate, it bulks 
large in our programme of work. Ask for Special Educational 
Folder giving full particulars of subjects taught by qualified 
teachers. Special lectures from time to time will be announced, 


CAFETERIA 


The Cafeteria was a new departure last fall, and is serving a 
large place in the community. Full meals, @ da carée, or light 
refreshments, are served from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. The Cafeteria is 
open to ladies. 


DORMITORIES 


Thirty-one men find a home away from home in the building 
dormitories. 


ULTIMATE PURPOSE OF THE ASSOCIATION 


It is, of course, the purpose of the Association that the whole 
programme should be Christian in its teachings and influence. 
There are certain definite ways, however, in which the principles 
upon which the Association is built are brought before the at- 
tention of our members. Sunday Afternoon Addresses, Week- 
night Meetings, Bible Study, Fireside Talks, stimulating interest 
in Christian work in foreign lands, particularly through the 
Association, will be emphasized during the coming months.

Boys’ Department 


The Boys’ Department aims to provide adequately 
for the all-round development of its members. This 
is accomplished in-the following ways : 


CLUBS 


Each boy on joining the Association becomes a member of a 
Club. The Club is generally the team on the gymnasium floor, 
and meets weekly for Bible Study; Group Discussions, Debates, 
etc. ‘‘Service for Others” is the keynote of all the clubs. Through 
the club system boys are enabled to learn co-operation with others 
and procedure at meetings. 


EDUCATIONAL CLASSES 


A class in High School subjects for working boysis held every 
Tuesday and Friday evening. This class is under the direction of 
Mr C. E. Ployart, Principal of Alfred Joyce School. 


WIRELESS CLUB 


A powerful Wireless Receiving Station is installed in the 
building, and classes for older boys in the construction and oper- 
ation of wireless apparatus are held every Wednesday evening. 


LIBRARY 


A Library of over 1000 boys’ books provides adequate reading 
of the right kind for all members of the Department. The Library 
is open every afternoon and evening. 


GAMES ROOM 


Two Billiard and one Ping-Pong Table, as well as Checker 
and Chess sets, constitute the equipment of the Games Room. 
Tournaments are held weekly. 


READING ROOM 


The Boys’ Reading Room is open all the time, and contains 
copies of all the best boys’ magazines. 


GYMNASIUM CLASSES 


Schedule of the Boys’ Gymnasium Classes will be found on 
page 3. Outdoor Games and special features are also held from 
time to time. 


BOYS’ MEMBERSHIP FEES, SEE INNER PAGE
